sources.snippet: This is an adapter checkpoint, not a standalone fused model. Load the exact initial Video2World backbone above first and then apply this LoRA checkpoint. For fused_video2world_dit, the initial checkpoint already includes the earlier WidowX/Bridge LoRA fusion; loading the original Bridge backbone instead would be incorrect.

sources.title: GitHub - Vizuara-AI-Lab/dreamzero-so101
sources.snippet: Fine-tuned DreamZero (Wan2.1-I2V-14B + joint action heads) on aggregated SO-101 LeRobot datasets. Predicts both future video and robot actions in a single forward pass using flow matching. Status: LoRA released at 72K training steps. Loss converged (action 0.249 → 0.0015, dynamics 0.176 → 0.0298). See Vizuara/dreamzero-so101-lora for weights and training curve.

sources.title: DreamZero-SO101 — Experimental Results
sources.snippet: How we stress-tested the world-action model DreamZero-SO101 is a joint video + action predictor. We probe its behaviour from three angles, each a stricter form of the previous. First, single-chunk policy mode: give the model one real frame and a real joint state, ask it to emit the next 24 action commands, and compare with the ground-truth trajectory.
